name: io.github.HOBSTER6615/rugradar
title: RugRadar: Solana rug & scam checker (rugradar-bgcm)
description: Solana-only rug checker: dev-wallet history, insider clusters, LP lock, honeypot test, x402 per call

tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Check a Solana token for rug-pull and scam risk. Input: a mint address, a pump fun or DexScreener link, or a $TICKER. Returns a 0-100 risk score (0-29 low risk, 30-59 caution, 60-100 high risk), plain-English red flags (mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, holder concentration, dev wallet and its launch history, linked insider wallets, LP lock, honeypot sell test, liquidity, drawdown) and a dump-model probability for tokens under 6 hours old. Read-only: never needs a wallet connection or signature. Free: 5 checks/day per IP (shared with the REST API); Pro key: unlimited. Automated risk signals, not financial advice. A low score is not a recommendation to buy.

query.description: Mint address, pump fun / DexScreener link, or $TICKER

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: scan_wallet
tools.description: List the SPL tokens held by a PUBLIC Solana wallet address, riskiest first, with a quick risk score and top red flags per token. Never send a private key or seed phrase. Free: the 3 riskiest tokens, 5 scans/day per IP; Pro key: every token, unlimited. Automated risk signals, not financial advice. A low score is not a recommendation to buy.

address.description: Public Solana wallet address (never a private key)

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: scan_link
tools.description: Scan a URL or pasted post text for wallet-drainer and phishing patterns (fake claim/airdrop pages, lookalike domains, wallet-connect bait). Free: 20/day per IP; Pro: unlimited.

text.description: A URL or pasted post text

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: get_pro_quote
tools.description: Get a payment quote for RugRadar Pro ($9 for 30 days, no auto-renewal): the exact USDC and SOL amounts, the Solana pay-to address, a unique reference to include in the payment (as a Solana Pay reference key or in an SPL Memo), a signed order token, and x402 details when available. Does not move funds; the agent or its user must send the payment from their own wallet.

tools.name: verify_payment_and_get_key
tools.description: After paying a quote, verify the Solana transaction on-chain (correct recipient, amount worth at least 95% of the price, carries the quote reference, confirmed, under 7 days old) and receive a RugRadar Pro API key valid for 30 days per payment. Idempotent: the same signature with the same order returns the same key; a signature can only be redeemed once.

signature.description: Solana transaction signature of the payment

tools.name: get_pro_status
tools.description: Check whether a RugRadar Pro API key is valid and when it expires, plus the current free and Pro limits.

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: watch_token
tools.description: Pro: add a token to this key's agent watchlist (up to 25). RugRadar stores a baseline snapshot (score, liquidity, holder concentration, dev and insider holdings, sell test, authorities). Poll get_watch_status to see what changed. There are no push notifications over MCP; for push alerts use the Telegram bot.

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: unwatch_token
tools.description: Pro: remove a token from this key's agent watchlist.

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

tools.name: get_watch_status
tools.description: Pro: re-check watched tokens (up to 5 stale ones per call; others use their last check) and report changes since each baseline: dev or insider wallets selling, liquidity pulled or draining, holder concentration jumps, sell test failing, authorities re-enabled, risk score or dump-model spikes, price halving. Automated risk signals, not financial advice. A low score is not a recommendation to buy.

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).

reset_baselines.description: After reporting, make the current readings the new baselines
